_README: Every drawing on the site. source is relative to D:/barnyard-source/ig (null for the brand mark and for the games still life, which has no photograph). crop and ignore rectangles are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the 1080-wide frame of the whole source; crop becomes the drawing's viewBox and the photograph's crop. credit comes from the matching slot in content/media.json. lift is true when the photograph may be shown under the drawing (false where a reel caption crosses the subject).
